svg.title: One effect, three strengths
svg.desc: Quake, Earthquake and Quake Sphere all pick the same effect, Quake, at three strengths: basic, stronger and strongest. Three pictures of the battle, taken at the same moment of each: Quake's pillars, which stand 32 frames, are already back in the ground; Earthquake's, which stand 64, are gone too and the party is still falling; Quake Sphere's, which stand 96, are still up.
svg.text: Quake, Earthquake and Quake Sphere all pick
the same effect, Quake, at three strengths.
The animation is the same; a stronger one
holds its rock pillars up longer.
